Note::replace_n¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::replace_n(std::string_view from, std::string_view to,
                     std::int64_t n) const

Substitute Up To The First n Occurrences¶

replace_n(from, to, n) returns a new Note, same shape as the input, with the first n occurrences of the literal string from in each cell rewritten to to, scanning left to right. Occurrences past the n-th are left untouched. It generalizes replace_first (n == 1) and replace (n large enough to cover every hit).

n¶

  • n <= 0 — a no-op; the cell is returned unchanged.

  • n greater than the number of occurrences — every occurrence is rewritten, same as replace.

  • Otherwise — exactly the first n, non-overlapping, are rewritten.

An empty from is a no-op regardless of n. The operation is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note.

Example 1: The First Two¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note({"alpha beta beta beta", "beta"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(n.replace_n("beta", "X", 2)) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["alpha X X beta", "X"]

Two of the three betas in cell 0 are rewritten; cell 1 has only one and it is rewritten.

Example 2: n Of Zero Is A No-Op¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note({"alpha beta beta beta", "beta"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(n.replace_n("beta", "X", 0)) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["alpha beta beta beta", "beta"]

Example 3: n Above The Count Rewrites Everything¶

const auto n = pluss::make_note({"alpha beta beta beta", "beta"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(n.replace_n("beta", "X", 99)) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["alpha X X X", "X"]

See Also¶

  • Note::replace_first: replace_n(from, to, 1).

  • Note::replace: rewrite every occurrence.

  • Note::replace_last: rewrite only the rightmost.
